scope: ReconnectEnrollment.psm1 fresh authorization and crash recovery; reviewed during owner freeze preparation

findings.location: Invoke-ReconnectRecovery completed_files/created_files validation and RemoveFile loop
findings.issue: An unsigned journal can claim a pre-existing identical signed dependency was newly created. Matching bundle hash proves content but not original absence or completion ownership, so recovery can delete a file this transaction did not create.
findings.required: Authenticate durable transaction/absence evidence, or conservatively preserve existing files rather than delete based on unsigned completed_files. In-memory rollback ownership is a distinct case.

findings.issue: Authorization-intent or half authorization/checksum pair survives a crash but no exported recovery path accepts that journal schema. Retrying Initialize refuses retained history or missing checksum; Repair accepts only enrollment journal fields.
findings.required: Add bounded authenticated authorization recovery or explicitly retain an incomplete manual-recovery gate. Do not call authorization crash recovery complete.

positive_boundaries: Signed payload/module/external runner verification precedes new identity writes.
Fresh identity creation refuses existing root history and uses exclusive flushed file creation.
Task recovery checks exact disabled task definition, fixed user/mode/path and signed bundle identity; foreign tasks are preserved.
activity: Read-only review; no live operations, source edits or full-suite reruns. Findings sent to root and enrollment owner.
